Biography: I'm currently a Postdoc at Tsinghua University, and a member of The System and Ubiquitous Networking (SUN) Group led by Prof. Yuan He. I received my PhD degree from Tsinghua University in 2026 and B.S. degree from University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC) in 2021.
Research Interests: RF Computing;   Wireless Channel Programming;   Wireless Sensing;   Metasurface/RIS.
